name: WNBA_R3A1B2_2020_IDENTITY_RESOLUTION_CONTRACT_V1

official_population_control.source_basis: WNBA official 2020 season announcement states a 22-game schedule for each of 12 teams.

resolution_rule.schedule_role: Secondary identity cross-check; one empirically identified missing schedule row is tolerated only if all independent population and pair controls pass.
resolution_rule.rescheduled_note_rule: Schedule rows whose note is exactly a RESCHEDULED FROM annotation remain regular-season games; rescheduling is not a special-event exclusion.

pass_requirements: Pinned team-box and schedule assets still match frozen SHA-256 and size.
Team-box season_type=2 contains exactly 132 unique games and 264 side rows.
Exactly 12 unique teams appear and every team appears in exactly 22 games.
Every game has exactly two coherent opponent rows with one home and one away side.
Every game has a parseable game_date and the two side rows agree on the date.
The schedule contains 131 of the 132 team-box game IDs, with no schedule-only IDs and exactly one team-box-only ID: 401241311.
All non-empty 2020 schedule note candidates are ordinary RESCHEDULED FROM annotations with active teams; no other special-event metadata candidate is present.
No score, winner, outcome or market values are projected.
